paths.description: Public root and server-error archetype. Chosen as the entry path and only reachable template; validates load, semantics, mobile/dark preferences, security, crawlability, performance, and recovery.

Route discovery via internal links, /robots.txt, and /sitemap.xml. No additional archetype was available: the DOM has no links and both discovery endpoints return 404. Authenticated, search, listing, manga-detail, reader, and account flows were not covered because no route or navigation to them could be discovered from the target.

findings.summary: The page ignores the user’s dark colour-scheme preference
findings.evidence: Desktop screenshots in default and prefers-color-scheme: dark are pixel-identical white pages; the DOM reports color-scheme: normal and no CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide dark surface/text colours with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: The error page offers no route back to useful content
findings.evidence: The rendered 404 contains no anchors, navigation landmark, home link, search, or recovery action.
findings.suggestedFix: Add descriptive recovery navigation, including a home link and search or section links, and visibly move focus to the error heading.

findings.summary: There is no keyboard, touch, or pointer recovery control
findings.evidence: The page-probe found zero focusable elements, so keyboard and touch users cannot recover from the 404 within the page.
findings.suggestedFix: Add adequately sized semantic links/buttons with visible :focus-visible treatment for recovery actions.

findings.summary: The public entry URL does not explain the site or expose a next action
findings.evidence: The first-viewport screenshot contains only “404 Not Found” and “nginx”; there is no site identity, content, or call to action.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve the intended homepage at /, or provide a branded error page that explains the site and offers a clear primary recovery action.

findings.summary: The primary experience is unavailable at the supplied public URL
findings.evidence: The main document returns HTTP 404. The DOM has no internal links or forms, and robots.txt and sitemap.xml also return 404, leaving no discoverable journey to exercise.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore routing/origin configuration so / serves the intended experience, then verify one representative reading/search journey end to end.

findings.summary: The 404 state has no useful recovery options
findings.evidence: The HTTP error is visible, but there is no explanation, retry, home link, search, or support route; the HAR confirms the document itself is 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the server-default page with an actionable branded 404 that preserves context and offers retry, home, search, and support options.

findings.summary: The error document lacks landmarks and a focusable recovery path
findings.evidence: The page-probe found one H1 but zero main/nav/header/footer/role landmarks and zero focusable controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap the error content in <main>, add labelled navigation, and place keyboard focus predictably on the error heading or primary recovery action.

findings.summary: The document omits the viewport meta tag
findings.evidence: At a requested 360×800 viewport, layout metrics report a 980 CSS-pixel layout viewport and scale 0.367 because meta[name=viewport] is absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> and retest reflow and target sizes.

findings.summary: The error document has no HTML doctype or declared charset
findings.evidence: The DOM probe reports doctype: null and browser-decoded characterSet: windows-1252; the source has no charset declaration.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit <!doctype html> and <meta charset="utf-8"> at the start of the error document.

findings.summary: The homepage has a generic error title and no meta description
findings.evidence: The DOM title is “404 Not Found” and meta[name=description] is absent.
findings.suggestedFix: After restoring the homepage, provide a unique descriptive title and concise visible-content-aligned meta description.

findings.summary: The response exposes no crawlable navigation or mobile viewport signal
findings.evidence: The page has zero anchors and no viewport meta; robots.txt returns 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve crawlable href-based navigation, a viewport meta tag, and an intentional robots.txt policy.

findings.summary: The public root and discovery endpoints return 404
findings.evidence: The discoverability primitive fetched the root with status 404; curl confirmed robots.txt and sitemap.xml also return 404, and no canonical link is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore a successful public root, publish consistent robots.txt and sitemap.xml, and add canonical URLs to indexable templates.

findings.summary: No structured or social-preview metadata describes the site
findings.evidence: The page-probe found zero JSON-LD blocks, zero Open Graph tags, and no canonical metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Organization/WebSite metadata and Open Graph/Twitter preview fields after the visible homepage is restored.

findings.summary: Key transport and content security headers are missing
findings.evidence: The headers primitive confirms HTTPS but finds no CSP, HSTS, or X-Content-Type-Options; the Cloudflare clearance cookie is Secure and HttpOnly.
findings.suggestedFix: Add HSTS, a restrictive CSP, and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff at the edge/origin; retain secure cookie flags.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policy coverage is incomplete
findings.evidence: X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN and Referrer-Policy: same-origin are present, but Permissions-Policy, CSP/frame-ancestors, HSTS, and nosniff are absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Define a least-privilege Permissions-Policy and CSP frame-ancestors, plus HSTS and nosniff.

findings.summary: The network failure state is a bare server page
findings.evidence: The representative HTTP failure state is only the nginx 404 and offers no retry, fallback content, or navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement an application-level 404 and network-failure fallback with clear status, retained context, and recovery actions.

findings.summary: The document language and direction are not declared
findings.evidence: The DOM probe reports empty html.lang and html.dir, so assistive technology and translation tools cannot identify the page language.
findings.suggestedFix: Set the correct BCP 47 lang value on <html>; set dir when needed and use logical properties in restored templates.
